description: Hi! We are Synergy, a team participating in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 in Zacatepec, Mexico. We aim to create software to monitor astronaut health during space missions. We are looking for motivated people interested in data analysis, visualization, AI/ML, UI/UX design, biomedical sciences, and communication. Previous hackathon experience is not required. We value creativity, teamwork, and a willingness to learn!
